Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N elements, find the Bitwise XOR of the array elements.
input_spec: The input consists of an integer N, representing the size of the array, followed by N array elements. The input size N is at most 100000.
output_spec: The output is the Bitwise XOR of all elements in the array.
